thread:
maria (PM): Quick sync — customer X asked for real-time chat streaming. We need to decide default protocol and delta schema for v1 API. Pros/cons: SSE easier for serverless and proxies, WS needed for multiplexing / binary tools. Also need finish_reason taxonomy for telemetry and for function-calling. Proposal below.

akshay (ENG): +1 to enumerate acceptance criteria before picking. What are the top constraints? latency, reconnect, multiplexing, proxies, cost.

maria (PM): Acceptance criteria: 1) low-latency per-token deltas (<50ms median) for hosted API; 2) graceful reconnect w/ resume for WS and simple recon if SSE; 3) function/tool calls must be streamable (partial args + final call); 4) auditability: final payload must include finish_reason and tokens; 5) clear backwards-compatible delta format; 6) docs + migration path.

joel (INFRA): SSE works well for our CDN+edge setup, avoids sticky WS, easier autoscale. But websockets give us client-initiated cancellations and binary frames for embeddings. Also SSE over HTTP/2 is messy. My preference: default SSE for simple single-tenant requests, offer WS for advanced use cases.

eli (ML): On delta format: don't stream full JSON blobs for structured output — send small deltas: {"delta":"text chunk"} and patch events for edits. For structured outputs, stream as line-delimited JSON chunks of top-level fields then final "complete" object.

sara (PD): How do deltas interact with function calling? We need to be able to stream partial arguments so devs can show progress. Example UX: show incremental assistant message, reveal function name only when confidently predicted, and stream args as they come.

rachel (SE): For SDKs, WS is easier for mobile apps that maintain persistent connection. But SSE is more firewall-friendly. We should provide the same event schema for both so devs can switch protocols with minimal code change.

akshay (ENG): Agreed. Proposal: canonical event shape (common across protocols) — envelope with `type` and `payload`. Examples:

```
{ "type": "delta", "payload": { "role":"assistant", "content":"the quick " } }
{ "type": "function_call", "payload": { "name":"get_weather", "args_delta":"{\"loc\":\"S\" }" } }
{ "type": "done", "payload": { "finish_reason":"stop", "total_tokens":245 } }
```

maria (PM): Finish reasons list suggestion: `stop`, `length`, `timeout`, `cancel`, `error`, `fallback`, `truncated`. Each should map to stable codes for telemetry.

eli (ML): Add `early_stop` to capture model-internal heuristics vs user cancel. But `cancel` can be user-initiated; `timeout` is platform/infra.

joel (INFRA): Reconnect semantics: for SSE we can't resume; so doc should recommend idempotent prompts or use `session_id` + checkpointing. For WS support resume via `last_seq` ack. Also add backpressure header and chunk-size hints.

sara (PD): Launch criteria: docs + SDK examples for both protocols, interop tests, e2e perf with 3 customer workloads, and a fallback policy (non-streaming) if client doesn't handle stream.

rachel (SE): Also need migration notes: if clients expect token-per-event granularity, we need to ensure burst patterns are similar across protocols.

maria (PM): Decision proposal: 1) Default public API: SSE with canonical event envelope; 2) Offer WS as opt-in for persistent/multiplexing use cases; 3) Delta schema = minimal `delta` text fragments + structured `field_patch` events for structured output; 4) Function calls stream `args_delta` and final `function_call` done event. 5) Use enumerated finish_reasons and numeric codes.

akshay (ENG): Implementation notes: runtime will produce the envelope; router can translate to SSE `event:` lines or WS JSON frames. We'll add `seq` ints on envelopes for resume support on WS only.

joel (INFRA): We'll add a compatibility header `X-Redwood-Stream-Version: 1` and allow `stream-resume` boolean for WS.

sara (PD): +1 from product. Customers to notify: Beta for WS in 2 weeks, SSE GA in 6 weeks after doc + SDKs.

maria (PM): Action items: akshay + infra to draft wire format + example SDK snippets (deadline Tue), docs + samples (rachel, Tue), perf test (eli). I'll collate and schedule stakeholder review Fri.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: none — manual merge required.

maria (PM): Any objections or missing items?

eli (ML): Add monitoring metrics: per-connection dropped events, avg delta latency, finish_reason counts.

rachel (SE): Add code snippets for reconnect patterns in mobile JS and python.

maria (PM): Great. I'll update the spec doc and tag everyone. :thumbsup:

akshay (ENG): SGTM.
